context: Tests whether the agent uses wp calculus and backward construction to implement a sequence of assignments that satisfy a specific postcondition.

checklist.name: Backward construction logic
checklist.description: Evidence (e.g., in comments) of calculating wp(C, Q) backwards from the postcondition.

checklist.name: Assignment rule usage
checklist.description: Correct substitution of expressions into the postcondition logic during derivation.

checklist.name: Correct precondition
checklist.description: The final derived precondition P is documented or asserted at the start.

checklist.name: Sequential composition
checklist.description: Correct chaining of wp(S1, wp(S2, Q)) for multiple statements.

checklist.name: Assertion presence
checklist.description: Includes native assertions (e.g. assert) for the final result.
